steps.title: Configure app dependencies, build scripts, and package settings
steps.description: Configure Gradle settings, Java 8 compatibility options, compileSdkVersion 34, and applicationId in build.gradle.

steps.title: Define AndroidManifest permissions, foreground service, and activity declarations
steps.description: Declare system permissions for Internet, foreground service media playback, notifications, wake locks, and configure main launcher activity metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Configure theme styles, dark palette color definitions, and UI strings
steps.description: Setup dark mode color palette, custom app strings for video player toolbar, history management, and paywall overlay controls in resource XML files.

steps.title: Create vector drawables for player navigation controls and UI containers
steps.description: Add vector graphic assets for playback action icons, exit buttons, rounded action buttons, and card background shapes.

steps.title: Design main activity layout container and lock paywall view overlay
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml layout structure with header navigation bar, web view container, network error placeholder, and dynamic premium paywall overlay.

steps.title: Design watch history list activity and custom history item layout
steps.description: Create activity_history.xml and item_history.xml layout structures for displaying saved video playback history records with clear options.

steps.title: Implement local SQLite database helper for video watch history storage
steps.description: Create HistoryDbHelper.java to handle SQLite database operations for adding, retrieving, deleting individual, and clearing all watch history items.

steps.title: Implement watch history adapter for ListView presentation
steps.description: Create HistoryAdapter.java to bind history models with custom item views and handle item removal callback listeners.

steps.title: Implement background media audio playback service and Notification Controller
steps.description: Develop BackgroundAudioService.java to maintain persistent background audio sessions, wake locks, media session state callbacks, and system notification controls.

steps.title: Implement paywall access status manager and device identifier validation
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager.java to query worker configuration endpoints, manage SharedPreferences access flags, and handle unique device ID generation.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity web engine, media bridge injection, and background audio integration
steps.description: Develop MainActivity.java to manage YouTube web rendering, JavaScript audio bridge, paywall verification status polling, and service binding.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Compile and assemble final debug APK for LockPlayTube application.
